correctness.rationale: For r=1,2, xdot=y²(kappa y^(2r−1)−1), ydot=a z²+xy, zdot=b x²+cxy, direct differentiation gives Lx as displayed and L(cy−z)=ac z²−b x². For compact stationary measures both integrate to zero and b E[x²]=ac E[z²]. The sign-changing polynomial is negative for y<h except y=0 and positive for y>h, h=kappa^(−1/(2r−1)). If an ergodic state is confined to either side, invariance forces y=0 or y=h and these invariant levels contain only equilibria. For y>=0, Lyapunov/Hölder norm monotonicity gives E[y²]^(1/2)<=h, strict for non-equilibrium ergodic states. Rational substitutions yield ac/b=6/11 for SL8II, 1 for SL8III. Independent polynomial checks verified exact cancellations. General mixtures of distinct equilibrium atoms can have RMS equality, so the equality wording must be understood as equilibrium-supported, not necessarily a single equilibrium Dirac mass.
